definitions.explanation: A small repair, correction, or improvement made to something that is mostly complete. Implies the changes are minor rather than a complete overhaul.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手直|てなお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make corrections to the document.

examples.japanese: ⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{手直|てなお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The design needs a few touch-ups.

examples.japanese: ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手直|てなお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: My boss asked me to make corrections before submitting, so it will take a little more time.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {直|なお}し (fixing). Implies relatively minor adjustments rather than a complete redo. Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb. Common in work, writing, and crafting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手直|てなお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make adjustments)
- {手直|てなお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ (adjustments are needed)
- {手直|てなお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (to add corrections)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧: revision, correction — more formal, often used for documents and software
- ⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: maintenance, care — ongoing upkeep rather than one-time fixes
